elements.label: One command opens a fresh read. Blue handles the request; green and purple own different data.
AI assistant
elements.detail: Choose a query and read its JSON response.
elements.note: Use query help and query schema to discover supported inputs and pagination. Read through these operations so the client does not depend on the Saga storage layout.

elements.label: Command-line entry
elements.detail: Check arguments, load Saga state, and route the request.
elements.note: The CLI checks arguments before opening application state. It emits a versioned success or error envelope, allowing the caller to branch on stable fields instead of parsing prose.

elements.label: Code and review
elements.detail: Read slides, code changes, evidence and coverage gaps.
elements.note: reviewapp validates the Saga, resolves the requested Git range, and supplies slide, coverage and code-ownership reads. A source-history failure is reported rather than replaced with an unrelated comparison.

elements.label: Product knowledge
elements.detail: Read stories and work plans; trace intent to delivery.
elements.note: Product queries open livingapp with the snapshot supplied by reviewapp. Requirements, work plans, traceability and readiness can therefore be read against the same Saga and source identity.

elements.label: CLI transport only
elements.detail: HTTP-query and stdio MCP adapters are not available.
elements.note: The structured query contract is exposed by the CLI. The proposed HTTP-query and stdio MCP adapters are not available query transports; the browser server does not substitute for them.
